## v0.8.9 — Tuner reference tones

**Tuner** no longer listens on the mic. It plays synth reference tones for the six Standard open strings (EADGBE, A4=440): select with `←` `→`, sustain with `Enter`. Speaker volume is fixed at a loud but non-clipping level.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.9** (Companion versionCode 11). Companion behavior is unchanged.

`cardputer_adv_firmware-0.8.9.bin` · `CardputerCompanion-0.8.9.apk`

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.8.9`
